text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Fitted G-all+D1 (G-all+D1+steps for the steps panel), final cut 2025-07-01. Capacity is cumulative over season-years and held at the last trained year. The PV term is negative because it is subtracted from demand. The drift path is the level the model carries into the forecast year.'
